fieldData.acrm---key-feature-4-content:
Every accident type reaches its owner

Send vehicle crashes to the fleet manager by email and injuries to HR in Slack. A report that mentions a hospital visit also alerts the safety lead the moment it is filed.
fieldData.awb---integration-feature-1:
Back strains that need a clinic reach HR the same day

Mattresses are heavy, and housekeepers lift them all shift. At Harborview Hotel, a housekeeper strains her lower back turning one in room 412. Her supervisor files the report with the task and the treatment. Any injury treated beyond first aid posts to the HR channel in Slack the same day, and this one went to a clinic.
fieldData.awb---integration-feature-2:
A fall in the shrub aisle goes on record with a witness

Garden hoses cross the shrub aisle at Greenleaf Garden Center, and a customer catches one with her foot and falls. A cashier who saw it types a short statement and signs on the staff tablet. The report holds 2 photos of the aisle and notes that the customer declined an ambulance. Tom, the owner, has it before closing.
fieldData.awb---mockup-data: window.awbMockup = { companyVehicles: "I manage a plumbing company with a fleet of service vans. Build an accident report my drivers fill out on their phones at the scene: the van number, the location, photos of the damage, the other driver's plate and insurer, and the police report number. When a crash involves another vehicle, email the whole report to our fleet manager.", employeeInjuries: "I run HR for a hotel. Build an injury report supervisors file when a housekeeper or porter gets hurt at work: the room or area, the task they were doing, the body part, and the treatment. If the injury needed more than first aid, send it to me in Slack the same day so I can start the claim.", customerFalls: "I own a garden center. Build an accident report my staff fill out on the store tablet when a customer trips or falls. Record the aisle, what happened, photos, whether the customer accepted medical help, and a statement and signature from any staff member who saw it. Email each report to me before closing.", claimFollowUp: "I'm the risk manager for a property management company. Link every accident report to its insurance claim number, with the property and the date the claim opened. Show me all open claims with the days each has been open, and put any claim open more than 30 days on a follow-up list with a button to email the adjuster." };
fieldData.awb---how-to-step-4-des: Decide who receives each kind of accident and how. Crashes might email the fleet manager while injuries post to an HR channel in Slack. Anything with a hospital visit can alert the safety lead too. Name a backup for nights and weekends.
fieldData.afb---prompt: Build an accident report form employees can fill out on a phone, right where it happened.

acrm---key-feature-2-image.alt: A Harborview Hotel supervisor files a lower back strain from room 412, and because the housekeeper went to a clinic, the report posts to the HR channel in Slack the same day for Omar.

acrm---key-feature-3-image.alt: A Greenleaf Garden Center cashier records a customer's fall in the shrub aisle with a signed witness statement and 2 photos, and the report goes to Tom, the owner.
